en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town nestled in a forested valley. In the foreground is a curved dirt road bordered by wooden posts and trees, with houses featuring sloped tiled roofs on either side. Further back, more town buildings and a distant church tower or similar structure are visible among dense hills covered with trees. Printed text along the bottom margin identifies the view as being from König Albert-Strasse in Tharandt and credits the publisher Brück & Sohn in Meissen.
